name: Fuente el Saúz (Spain)
description: Tierced at the hoist, green with a yellow crenellated edge, and white in the fly charged with the crowned municipal arms of Fuente el Saúz (a fountain and a willow on red).
history: The arms and the flag were approved officially on 1 July 2003 (Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León no. 136 of 16 July 2003); the flag is of 2:3, tierced at the hoist, the hoist green with an embattled yellow wall and the fly white with the municipal arms.

features.role: crenellated (embattled) edge between green and yellow
